## Current state: token-driven dark slate, no frame Root `.dx-pricing` (`x402-pricing.css:6-14`): `display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:20px; padding:20px`, no `max-width`, no background, no border, no radius. It bleeds edge-to-edge in the host frame and relies on `openai/widgetPrefersBorder: true` for its only outline. The wallet by contrast is a hard object: `.dxw-widget` `max-width:390px; margin:0 auto; background:var(--paper); border-radius:24px; padding:22px 22px 8px` + a three-layer shadow (`wallet.css:34-46`). ### Color — everything comes from `--dx-*` slate tokens (`base.css:57-89`) | role | pricing (dark default) | wallet (direction B) | |---|---|---| | page/surface | `--dx-bg-quiet: rgba(15,23,42,.45)` (slate, translucent) | `--page #F1EEE8`, `--paper #FFFDF9` (cream paper, opaque) | | text | `--dx-fg #f8fafc` / `--dx-fg-muted #cbd5f5` / `--dx-fg-quiet #94a3b8` | `--ink #1D1710` / `--ink-2 #6F6659` / `--ink-3 #A39784` | | borders | `--dx-border rgba(148,163,184,.22)` cool grey | `--hair rgba(61,50,39,.10)` warm hairline | | accent | `--dx-accent #ff7a1a` | `--ember #F2681A` (+ `--gold #CBAD72`) | | semantics | `--dx-success #34d399`, `--dx-warn #fbbf24`, `--dx-danger #f87171` (all cool/neon) | none — the wallet has no traffic-light palette | `#ff7a1a` vs `#e8641f`/`#F2681A`: close but not the same orange. The pricing sheet uses `--dx-accent` in exactly three places — the `--best` route row tint (`:577-580`), the prescription bubble (`:275-279, :327`), and the Doctor copy-button focus ring (`:547`). ### Typography - Body font: `"Inter", system-ui, …` from `base.css:10` — **matches** the wallet's `"Inter", system-ui` (`wallet.css:16`). No Inter Display anywhere in pricing. - Mono: `--dx-font-mono: 'IBM Plex Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', …` (`base.css:48`) — the wallet hard-picks `"JetBrains Mono"` first (`wallet.css:29`). **Different first-choice face; the two widgets will render different mono.** - Type scale is a fixed px ladder (`base.css:25-32`): xs 11 / sm 12 / base 13 / md 14 / lg 16 / xl 18 / 2xl 22 / 3xl 28. The title is 22px (`:73`), body 14px, most chrome 10-11px uppercase. - **Money is NOT mono in the routes table.** `.dx-pricing__route-price` is `--dx-text-lg` (16px) semibold with `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` but the default sans face (`:628-633`). The wallet's money is 44px JetBrains Mono with a separate 26px currency mark and 26px cents (`wallet.css:52-62`). Direct clash on the single most important thing this widget shows. - Mono IS used for: payTo address (`:622-626`), thermometer number `/100` cap, verdict eyebrow/footer, doctor copy button, preview body, stamp letter (900 weight). - Uppercase + wide tracking is the dominant chrome idiom: section titles `--dx-tracking-widest` (.14em) uppercase 11px (`:98-105`); eyebrows/footer/rail-cap 9-10px uppercase `--dx-tracking-wider` (.08em). The wallet uses almost no uppercase — one exception is the card brand at .22em (`wallet.css:100-104`). ### Spacing & radii 4px scale (`base.css:14-22`). Root gap 20px between every block — flat rhythm, no grouping. Radii: `sm 6 / md 10 / lg 14 / pill 999` (`base.css:52-55`); pricing uses `md` (10px) for bubbles, route rows, preview body, state boxes. Wallet uses 24px on the frame, 14px on the card, 999px on pills — a distinctly larger, softer geometry. ### Patterns that already carry real character (worth preserving, not deleting) 1. **Ruled-paper speech bubble** (`:231-255`) — two layered `linear-gradient`s: a horizontal rule every 24px (`background-position: left 18px`) and a vertical margin rule 14-15px from the right edge. notes: ## Reference implementation to match - Approved spec artifacts: `/home/branchmanager/websites/dexter-mcp/apps-sdk/design-reference/wallet-widget-B-calm-home-sheets.html` and `.png` (plus `README.md`). - Live code: `apps-sdk/ui/src/styles/widgets/wallet.css` (416 lines, all `dxw-` namespaced) and `apps-sdk/ui/src/components/wallet/*`. - The wallet's structural moves worth stealing: a single hard-edged 390px paper card (`wallet.css:34-46`), a `:where(.dxw-root) button` reset so hand-rolled buttons win without `!important` (`:23-27`), a `.dxw-mono` utility that pins JetBrains Mono + tabular-nums (`:29`), one-sheet-at-a-time bottom sheets (`components/wallet/Sheet.tsx:8-24` — scrim + grabber + title + close, state owned by `WalletHome`), and an inline-SVG brand lockup (`components/wallet/Lockup.tsx`) instead of a remote ``. - The wallet declares its own local CSS custom properties on `.dxw-root` (`wallet.css:8-21`) rather than consuming `--dx-*`. If the pricing widget follows suit with a `.dxp-`/local-token approach, **it must not break the shared Professor/Doctor components that the search widget also renders** — those currently read `--dx-success/warn/danger/accent/bg-quiet/border/fg*` from `base.css`. ## Where the design opportunity actually is The single biggest finding of this audit: **the server ships far more than the renderer draws.** Specifically dropped and available for free (no server work): - `enrichment.resource.quality_score` — the catalog's headline 0-100 number, currently invisible; the widget shows only a per-run `ai_score`. - `verification_status` + `last_verified_at` — "verified 3 days ago" is on the wire. - `latency_p50_ms` / `latency_p95_ms` and `history.summary.median_duration_ms` / `p95_duration_ms` — "typically 340ms" for a "should I pay for this?" surface. - `history.summary.total` / `passes` / `fails` — the all-time pass rate (the footer currently says "2 of 3 recent runs passed" because it only counts the slice). - `zauth_verified`, `erc8004_agent_id`, `erc8004_reputation_score` — identity proofs. - `docs_url`, `openapi_spec_url` — a legitimate secondary action. - `HistoryRow.paid` / `payment_network` / `payment_tx_signature` — proof Dexter actually paid real money to test this endpoint, which is a strong trust beat and currently thrown away. - `authMode` — would let the widget distinguish paid / siwx / apiKey / free without inference (and fix bug #1). - `inputSchema` / `outputSchema` — the request and response shape; the widget shows a sample response body but never the request contract. - `enrichment_source` — lets the surface say "not in the Dexter catalog" honestly instead of silently omitting the whole verdict block. ## Tool-call chain for testing `x402_check` (this widget) → `x402_fetch` (renders the `x402-fetch-result` widget, `open-mcp-server.mjs:138`). Live MCP tools are available in this session (`mcp__dexter-x402__x402_check`) if the designer wants a real payload; `mcp__dexter-x402__x402_search` will surface real catalog URLs — pick one with catalog enrichment (a `x402.dexter.cash` or `api.dexter.cash` resource is most likely to have verifier history) and one raw third-party URL to see the no-enrichment path. Useful payload-shape probes without paying anything: - Enriched paid: any catalog URL → `authMode: 'paid'`, `enrichment_source: 'live_db'`. - No enrichment: any x402 endpoint not in the catalog → `enrichment: null`, `enrichment_source: 'not_found'` → Professor/Doctor/ResponseShape all vanish, leaving identity + description + routes + button. **This is the most common real-world state and the current design has almost nothing to show in it.** - Error: a URL that 404s → `error: true, statusCode: 404, message: "Client error: 404"`. ## Build & deploy Vite multi-page build; the compiled asset is committed at `public/apps-sdk/assets/x402-pricing-*.js`. Per Branch's standing rule, **subagents don't build live repos** — the controller builds and restarts `dexter-mcp` under PM2. The widget URI is versioned (`apps-sdk/widget-uris.mjs:22`, `versionedWidgetUri`), so a stale cached resource is a real failure mode after deploy; verify the `data-widget-build` stamp through the `[debug]` panel after restart. ## Copy currently on the surface (for the rewrite pass) "Checking pricing…" / "Still probing endpoint — hang tight." / "Authentication required" / "This endpoint requires provider authentication before the x402 payment flow." / "Pricing unavailable" / "No payment options are currently available for this endpoint." / "No payment required — this endpoint is free to use." / "Free" / "Pay via" / "Best" / "One-shot payment" / "Streaming tab" / "Metered tab" / "What you'll get" / "View sample response" / "Hide sample response" / "Fetch & pay $X" / "Professor Dexter grades it" / "Doctor Dexter prescribes" / "prescription" / "evaluated by Dexter · 38m ago · 5 of 6 recent runs passed" / "No notes returned." / "Unknown endpoint" / "Response" / "Binary blob" / "Streaming response". Two of these read as internal nouns on a user surface: **"Streaming tab" / "Metered tab"** (`PaymentRoutes.tsx:21-24`) and the mono-uppercase **"prescription"** rail cap (`DoctorDexterCard.tsx:29`). The Professor footer deliberately says "evaluated by Dexter" and never mentions the paid verification mechanic (`ProfessorDexterCard.tsx:23-25`) — that restraint is intentional, keep it.
